units.name: PresentationVectors
units.summary: Bank 0 entry jumps select initialization, title handling, game over, stage approach, ending presentation or shooter gameplay.

units.name: InitializePresentation
units.summary: Select CHR, clear presentation and pause state, install split metasprite pointer tables, and prepare the screen before entering the title sequence.

units.name: TitleSelection
units.summary: Run the title selector once per frame. Select toggles the stored menu choice; Start discards this caller and enters the chosen start/password path. The small rendering phase counter is shared with NMI gating.

units.name: DrawTitleScreen
units.summary: Set sprite priority behind background, prepare both nametables and submit a sequence of inline drawing descriptors. Calls consume following words; those words are not instructions.

units.name: DrawTitleCursor
units.summary: Position the selected title marker relative to horizontal scroll, render its metasprite, and hide the rest of the reserved sprite slots.

units.name: OpeningScreenSequence
units.summary: Hide background while loading opening graphics, reveal sprite layers and cycle four palette blocks with timed waits. This is a presentation sequence, not ordinary player movement.

units.name: OpeningPaletteBlocks
units.summary: Prepare a palette transfer and copy a selected 16-byte palette into its payload. Wait eight frames before submitting the descriptor.

units.name: AnimateOpeningPair
units.summary: Advance two pairs of fractional coordinates on alternating frames, clamp one horizontal coordinate to the other, and alternate rendering order. Stop at the sequence counter limit.

units.name: DrawOpeningPair
units.summary: Convert each animated coordinate pair into the shared metasprite inputs; the animation counter supplies frame and attribute variation.

units.name: StreamStoryRow
units.summary: Read 24 text tiles per row and an eight-byte attribute block at the appropriate cadence. A $FF row marks the end and produces spaces. Advance source and nametable row selectors separately.

units.name: SecondQuestCongratulations
units.summary: Dispatch by quest flag: first quest uses the attention message, second quest loads the congratulations presentation. Parse length-prefixed screen records, load palette state and run the timed scene.

units.name: EndingFrame
units.summary: Wait for NMI, submit a pending palette update, acknowledge it and move the background star sprites.

units.name: FirstQuestAttention
units.summary: Clear the display and reveal the attention message a character at a time, wrapping at column 28 and advancing two tile rows. A negative byte terminates the text.

units.name: StarfieldAndNametableFill
units.summary: Seed a deterministic bit-feedback generator, populate the star sprite range, and move stars by half a screen. The later fill path writes repeated tile rectangles across a nametable.

units.name: FillSecondNametable
units.summary: Reuse the nametable fill with the second nametable base.

units.name: NextPresentationRandom
units.summary: Run twelve feedback steps on the two-byte state while preserving X. When a nonzero bound is installed, reduce the result by repeated subtraction. This is presentation randomness; no statistical quality claim follows.

units.name: PacedInlineDrawing
units.summary: Preserve A around an optional frame wait, then tail-call an inline descriptor reader. The busy flag allows a sequence to submit transfers without a wait between each record.

units.name: StageApproachMap
units.summary: Install approach metasprite/metatile tables, clear map buffers, paint the stage markers and distinguish the completed stages using the selected stage index.

units.name: StageApproachCaption
units.summary: Copy the approach caption and replace its four-character ordinal from the stage-indexed table. The table covers the eight visible stage choices.

units.name: ApproachTimedWait
units.summary: Fade in and wait a 16-bit frame count while the approach marker animates; then enter the fade-out continuation.

units.name: ApproachFrame
units.summary: Wait for a frame, flush a pending palette, move star sprites and draw a blinking marker at the selected stage location.

units.name: SelectStartRoute
units.summary: Choose direct start or password entry using title choice and prior-start state. Resume combines the stored stage and quest bits; a fresh direct start uses selector zero.

units.name: PasswordCursorInput
units.summary: Compare held buttons with the prior frame to implement an initial 32-frame and repeating 8-frame delay. Left/right edges move the four-character password cursor within bounds.

units.name: EditPasswordCharacter
units.summary: Adjust the selected password tile with repeated up/down input and wrap between digits and uppercase letters. Redraw the four-character field after each change.

units.name: DrawPasswordCursor
units.summary: Place the cursor sprite eight pixels apart beneath the selected character and continue editing until Start is pressed.

units.name: ComparePassword
units.summary: Compare four entered bytes against each candidate in sequence, advancing the pointer four bytes per failure. Selectors 1 through 15 are tested; failure hides the cursor and requests an error sound.

units.name: AcceptStageSelector
units.summary: Split selector X into stage index (bits 0..2) and quest flag (bit 3), reset lives and stack, mark a started game, and enter the bank-switching start path. This is the consumer proof for the password table; $C8 is not the stage number.

units.name: ShooterProgression
units.summary: Run frames until the route boundary or player sequence state changes. The life-loss path decrements lives, installs a temporary recovery interval, and routes exhaustion to the fixed-bank dispatcher.

units.name: ShooterFrame
units.summary: Wait for the video frame, flush palette changes, sample held input and skip simulation while paused. Otherwise update scrolling, player, projectile/object handlers and collisions, then hide unused OAM slots.

units.name: ShooterLivesAndSpawnBoundary
units.summary: Render the lives display through the shared digit renderer. The following entry checks whether the spawn cursor has reached its terminal pointer.

units.name: ShooterSpawnRecord
units.summary: Compare each four-byte spawn position with scroll and search twelve object slots. Initialize type, coordinate, health and state arrays, then advance the stream by four bytes.

units.name: ShooterObjectRender
units.summary: Walk twelve active nonnegative object slots, age flash counters, prepare signed sprite coordinates and dispatch through the 31-entry type handler table.

units.name: AdvanceShooterScroll
units.summary: Near the route end, decelerate a signed 16-bit velocity toward zero. Accumulate its fractional part and move the world only when the integer carry is nonzero, then inspect spawning.

units.name: TestMetatileCollision
units.summary: Fetch the metatile at world coordinates, select a quadrant mask from the low coordinate bits and return carry set for a blocking quadrant. Values below $40 pass without collision.

units.name: CullProjectilesAtTiles
units.summary: Test the two player-shot slots and eight secondary slots against world metatiles after adding scroll and a four-pixel center offset. Clear the active flag on collision.

units.name: ShooterPlayerSequence
units.summary: Dispatch normal, damage/recovery and route-end player states with separate timers and progression. Route-end scripts center the player and animate the arrival craft before fixed interior dispatch.

units.name: MoveShooterPlayer
units.summary: Apply held directional input to fractional screen positions, clamp X to the visible range and Y to the playfield, and derive world coordinates and collision-center coordinates from scroll.

units.name: SpawnShooterShot
units.summary: On a fresh A/B press, find one of two free shot slots, place it relative to the player and request the shot sound. The following helper copies player coordinates to metasprite inputs.

units.name: ShooterShotObjectCollision
units.summary: Compare each active player shot with type-specific object bounds. Consume the hit shot and apply its power; zero/borrow health enters the type-specific death transformation.

units.name: ShooterPlayerObjectCollision
units.summary: Test player bounds against twelve objects. Pickup types update resources/ammunition/recovery; other contacts trigger damage unless recovery protects the player.

units.name: ShooterPlayerSecondaryCollision
units.summary: Test eight secondary positions against the player rectangle, clear the hit secondary and enter damage unless recovery is active.

units.name: ShooterPlayerTileCollision
units.summary: Test two points on the player against metatile solidity. If either hits and neither recovery nor a sequence is active, enter the damage sequence and request a sound.

units.name: InitializeFortressInterior
units.summary: Load stage-dependent room data into cartridge RAM, clear progression counters, reset scroll and draw the entry screens. Fade in, start music and wait for the entry presentation.

units.name: InteriorMainLoop
units.summary: Run interior frames, dispatch requested sequences and test the paired exit-marker tiles. The exit transition matches an 11-byte record by aligned world coordinate before loading destination graphics/position.

units.name: InteriorFrame
units.summary: Wait for a frame and flush palette changes. Advance the 13-step screen-effect phase, update player, objects and collisions, render the HUD when allowed, and dispatch pause handling and sequence transitions. Zero energy takes a separate continuation.

units.name: InteriorPresentationFrame
units.summary: Wait for one frame and acknowledge a pending palette upload; this callback supports fades without running the full simulation.

units.name: SeekInteriorSpawnPage
units.summary: Select the orientation-dependent spawn stream and seek length-prefixed page records. Adjust the visible edge by one page or 32 pixels, then scan fixed five-byte entries matching that edge.

units.name: AllocateInteriorObject
units.summary: Reject records whose persistence bit is already set or whose identifier is already active. Find a free one of twelve slots, initialize its type, and place it at the appropriate viewport edge. Record direction relative to the player in bit flags.

units.name: InitializeObjectSlot
units.summary: Store type-indexed initial parameters and reset the parallel object arrays. Object state occupies separate twelve-element arrays rather than contiguous per-object records.

units.name: DrawInteriorObjects
units.summary: Convert a 13-step phase and amplitude into signed screen displacement, then walk twelve objects. Apply displacement and flash attributes, select a type handler, and dispatch animation state separately.

units.name: CallObjectHandler
units.summary: Tail-dispatch through the selected two-byte handler pointer; its bank context is supplied by the caller.

units.name: InteriorShotObjectCollision
units.summary: Scan twelve object rectangles for each active shot, apply type reactions and power, consume the shot and start an area effect for the powered variant.

units.name: InteriorPlayerObjectCollision
units.summary: Test secondary hits and accept ordinary A fire or ammunition-gated powered B fire in eligible player states; apply damage/recoil using the shared resource helpers.

units.name: InteriorProjectileTileCollision
units.summary: Convert shot/secondary screen positions to 240-line world coordinates, test metatiles, clear collisions and handle destructible tiles plus bounded object effects.

units.name: DispatchRoomEvents
units.summary: Select a viewport-edge mode, decide whether scrolling aligns with an event boundary, and seek length-prefixed room records. Each entry carries a command type and optional position; handler pointers and type lengths drive bounded traversal within the record.

units.name: RoomEventSubstream
units.summary: Gate one event on player state and scroll alignment. A nested-stream helper saves and restores the caller stream pointer around dispatch through a pointer stored in the record.

units.name: TestRoomEventPosition
units.summary: Compare the event identifier and two world-coordinate pairs against a seven-by-nine tolerance. Match state chooses sound, orientation and room transition fields; state six bypasses the transition.

units.name: DispatchPlayerRoomState
units.summary: Clear a matching event state at sequence six, then use the current state as a word index into the player-state handler table.

units.name: UpdateInteriorPlayer
units.summary: Skip simulation in a designated sequence, otherwise dispatch the player state or apply temporary input filtering. Recompute collision center, run terrain/sound checks, age flash counters and render the player before resource updates.

units.name: DrawInteriorPlayer
units.summary: Choose movement/idle frames from signed motion and state, alternate some frames on a timer, and combine facing, flicker and temporary attributes before drawing the player metasprite.

units.name: AdvanceInteriorVerticalPosition
units.summary: Increment the 16-bit world Y coordinate with a 240-pixel page wrap. Depending on orientation and boundary flags, scroll the viewport or move the on-screen player.

units.name: InteriorTerrainEffect
units.summary: Scan the sampled tile array for special values, derive an environmental flag and pace an effect with the frame counter. Resource updates use a separate shared helper; their exact units are unresolved.

units.name: InteriorTerrainAudioAndDrain
units.summary: Gate sounds from terrain flags and sound occupancy, maintain a latch for persistent terrain sound, and set the flash timer. Held movement/thrust bits consume a byte accumulator; on underflow a resource helper is invoked.

units.name: ResetHardwareAndState
units.summary: Reset mapper serial state, disable video, clear cartridge RAM pages $6000..$66FF, wait for PPU warmup and initialize stack and video shadows. Reset software queues/scroll/audio, check a six-byte retained signature and enter the bank-zero presentation vector.

units.name: IrqReturn
units.summary: The classified IRQ vector target immediately returns from interrupt; no IRQ-driven subsystem is established by this fragment.

units.name: DrawMetatileQuad
units.summary: Convert coarse world coordinates into a nametable address and map-buffer pointer. Expand four metatile indices through four quadrant tile tables, submit the tile rectangle, pack four two-bit palettes, update attribute shadow and submit its byte.

units.name: AdvanceHorizontalScroll
units.summary: Restore saved drawing registers at the first entry. The next routine shifts world objects with horizontal scroll and invokes metatile streaming at the edge; page overflow increments the high byte.

units.name: StreamHorizontalEdge
units.summary: At alternating pixels, convert scroll and page coordinates into a four-tile-aligned metatile position, add the edge displacement and tail-call the metatile renderer.

units.name: AdvanceVerticalScroll
units.summary: Shift object coordinates and advance vertical scroll with 240-line wrapping, then choose the edge-streaming displacement.

units.name: StreamVerticalEdge
units.summary: Convert scroll into a metatile-aligned row and call the renderer. A second entry derives 32-unit viewport limits from world-coordinate page bits.

units.name: DrawVerticalMargins
units.summary: Draw the rows just above and below the viewport, then run the vertical-scroll continuation. A shared loop steps across the metatile columns.

units.name: CheckScrollBoundary
units.summary: Compensate neighboring page coordinates at viewport edges, compare them with stage width/height, and choose the rotating map buffer before invoking the packed-column loader.

units.name: ReadWorldMetatile
units.summary: Choose one of four map-buffer quadrants from the world page bits, divide both pixel coordinates by sixteen, and return the metatile index at the resulting packed row/column.

units.name: WriteWorldMetatile
units.summary: Store a metatile into the selected map buffer, expand its four tile quadrants into a two-by-two transfer and merge its two-bit palette into the proper attribute quadrant. Submit both tile and attribute updates while preserving X.

units.name: RestoreMetatileCaller
units.summary: Restore the caller X register after the tile and attribute updates and return.

units.name: DispatchSecondaryObjects
units.summary: Walk eight active secondary slots and use their type as a word index into a handler table. The indirect jump continues processing through type-specific code.

units.name: RenderSecondaryObjects
units.summary: Walk eight slots whose active state is one, prepare their screen coordinates and tail-dispatch their type-specific render handler.

units.name: MovePlayerShots
units.summary: Move two active shots left or right by the shared speed. Arithmetic overflow clears the active flag; the coordinate wraps only in inactive slots.

units.name: DrawPlayerShots
units.summary: Prepare each active shot for the shared metasprite renderer, select a four-frame animation from the frame counter and apply horizontal flip for its direction.

units.name: TransformPalette
units.summary: Transform a selected range from the source palette into the upload palette with signed brightness steps and clamping. An optional color remap exchanges intensity/color values; universal background color is propagated across subpalettes.

units.name: ChooseSpriteOrder
units.summary: Choose forward or reverse OAM allocation from scene and progression state, alternating order when allowed. This spreads sprite priority across frames.

units.name: DrawMetasprite
units.summary: Index split low/high pointer tables by metasprite ID. Each descriptor has a count followed by Y offset, tile, attributes and X offset. Add signed 16-bit origins, discard sprites off either axis, XOR caller attributes and allocate OAM forward or backward by four bytes.

units.name: HideUnusedSprites
units.summary: Fill remaining OAM Y positions with $F0 using the current allocation direction. Tile and attribute bytes need no clearing when Y hides the sprite.

units.name: TogglePause
units.summary: On a Start edge toggle pause state and request the pause sound on entry. The shared tail disables NMI, ticks audio and reenables NMI so audio remains serviced while paused.

units.name: DrawDigitRun
units.summary: Draw a horizontal sequence of digit metasprites, suppressing leading zeros except the last position. Each digit advances X by eight pixels.

units.name: DrawDecimalHud
units.summary: Convert the 16-bit source value to five decimal digits by accumulating powers-of-two decimal rows with carry. Draw that digit run and a separate two-digit field at fixed HUD positions; the resource names remain uncertain.

units.name: PaletteFade
units.summary: Step signed palette brightness once every four callback frames until it reaches the target. The alternate entry walks brightness downward. The callback pointer permits scene-specific work during fades.

units.name: FinishFadeOrCallFrame
units.summary: Clear the fade-active flag and return. A separate entry tail-calls the frame callback through its zero-page pointer.

units.name: LoadStageRoomData
units.summary: Select stage metadata by stage index and quest, set a cartridge-RAM destination and switch the source PRG bank. The mapper value passed here is not an effective 8 KiB bank index.

units.name: CopyStageRoomPages
units.summary: Copy full 256-byte pages through indirect pointers until destination high reaches $7F. In second quest swap selected four-byte palette groups before restoring the scene mapper. This runtime window is not an independent ROM table extent.

units.name: SwitchGameMode
units.summary: Switch PRG and dispatch the bank-zero approach or bank-four interior initialization. Reset the stack before entering the new mode. Ending dispatch selects bank zero and jumps through its presentation vector; artificial visits do not prove natural completion.

units.name: ShiftObjectsLeft
units.summary: Subtract one from player shots, secondary slots and object coordinates as the viewport moves. Crossing the visible boundary clears slot activity or adjusts the signed coordinate high byte.

units.name: ShiftObjectsUp
units.summary: Subtract one from shot, secondary and object Y positions and the extra coordinate accumulator. Clear active slots on vertical underflow.

units.name: NmiService
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, apply pending video mask, upload OAM page two by DMA, drain queued PPU transfers, set the frame semaphore, read controllers and advance the frame counter. Scene/pause flags gate game/audio and title shortcut work.

units.name: NmiReturnAndScroll
units.summary: Restore registers and return from NMI. The next entry prepares scroll shadows from world scroll or the interior screen-effect helper, writes PPU address/scroll latches and updates mapper control from orientation state.

units.name: ApplyScreenDisplacement
units.summary: Copy base scroll, look up signed displacement components from a 13-step phase and amplitude, wrap vertical coordinates at 240 pixels and keep nametable selector bits within one bit.

units.name: NmiControlAndFrameWait
units.summary: Disable or enable NMI through the PPUCTRL shadow. The frame wait preserves A, clears a semaphore and waits for NMI; when NMI is disabled it polls the PPU vblank bit instead.

units.name: PollVblank
units.summary: Wait for vblank to end and then begin, preserving A across the polling fallback. This avoids waiting forever on a disabled NMI semaphore.

units.name: WriteMmc1Registers
units.summary: Serialize five low bits of A into MMC1 control or CHR registers. CHR writes disable NMI around the serial transaction and reenable it on return; register values are mapper settings, not physical bank identities.

units.name: WriteMmc1Prg
units.summary: Serialize the PRG selection value while NMI is disabled, then reenable NMI. The following entry installs an orientation/control preset.

units.name: SetOrientationPreset
units.summary: Install the alternate mapper/orientation shadow preset used by scrolling and metatile addressing.

units.name: VideoModeAndTileAddress
units.summary: Wait a frame before changing rendering, then compute a nametable address from X/Y tile coordinates. Orientation swaps the table axes; coordinate bit five selects the neighboring nametable.

units.name: ReadInlineTransferDescriptor
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, pop the JSR return address and read the following two-byte descriptor pointer. Advance the saved return by two and push it back so RTS skips the inline argument. Alternate entries select copy or repeat modes; never decode those argument bytes as linear code.

units.name: DrawTransferRectangle
units.summary: Read destination, width and height from the descriptor. Copy or repeat payload bytes per row, directly to PPU when rendering is disabled or into the NMI queue when enabled. Advance destination by 32 per row and restore the caller registers.

units.name: DrawTransferColumn
units.summary: The alternate rectangle path marks vertical PPU increment in the destination high byte. Its remaining direct/queued body is only partly classified; the call to the queue writer is established.

units.name: WaitForPpuQueueSpace
units.summary: Compare producer and consumer positions modulo 256 and wait for a frame when 64 or more bytes are outstanding. This is queue backpressure, not a new record boundary.

units.name: PpuQueueAndDrain
units.summary: Reserve an address header in the page-three byte queue, append payload through a private cursor and commit by publishing the producer index. NMI drains records within a 48-byte consumption budget, using destination bit seven for vertical increment.

units.name: PpuDrainInputAndAudioInit
units.summary: Complete queued PPU writes and palette latch cleanup. Then latch both controllers, serially read eight bits, derive newly pressed edges and hide sprites. Audio initialization resets software channels and APU state; FDS register writes remain in this cartridge build without proving FDS hardware use.

units.name: SoundEffectPriority
units.summary: Compare requested effect masks and priorities against five effect slots, rejecting lower-priority conflicts and allocating compatible channels.

units.name: StartOrStopSoundEffect
units.summary: Resolve an effect descriptor, initialize available effect slots and combine their channel masks. The stop entry clears five effect slots and restores register defaults.

units.name: InitializeSoundChannel
units.summary: Reset per-channel note/envelope/transposition fields, read stream pointers and hardware channel offset from a descriptor, and start its duration counter.

units.name: StartMusicAndTickAudio
units.summary: Clear music slots, resolve a track descriptor and allocate five music channels. The tick entry updates ten logical channels, executes note/envelope streams and merges effect/music register shadows according to active channel masks.

units.name: FlushAudioRegisters
units.summary: For each hardware channel, choose music or effect shadows and write only values changed from the last hardware shadow. FDS-range writes are present but do not establish cartridge expansion audio.

units.name: AudioNoteStream
units.summary: Age note duration, fetch commands when it expires and distinguish note data from control bytes. Noise/DMC-like channel handling differs from pitched channels. Pitch, duration and gate helpers update the selected logical channel.

units.name: AudioNoteParameters
units.summary: Calculate note duration from table rows and per-channel modifier, configure the next envelope stream and process high control commands. Commands $F0/$F1 set or adjust a clamped high volume nibble.

units.name: AdjustAudioVolume
units.summary: Read a signed adjustment, add it to the high volume nibble and clamp at zero or fifteen before combining it with the low envelope nibble.

units.name: AudioControlCommands
units.summary: Dispatch duration, wait, pitch offset, transposition and envelope selection commands, then continue note-stream interpretation.

units.name: AudioStreamControlFlow
units.summary: Use a channel-specific software stack for stream jump, call/return and counted loops. $F8 loads a pointer, $FA saves a return pointer, $FB restores it, and $FC/$FD implement counted repetition. These are audio stream controls, not CPU subroutines.

units.name: AudioFetchPitchAndEnvelope
units.summary: Advance the stream pointer with carry. Resolve pitch through a channel-dependent word table and preserve a hardware trigger bit in its high byte. Gate expiry switches envelope phase; envelope timing drives the next command.

units.name: AudioEnvelopeCommands
units.summary: Decode signed pitch nibbles, clamped volume and duty/wave selection. The wave path loads 64 values into FDS wave RAM and releases write mode afterward.

units.name: ApplyAudioVolume
units.summary: Combine high volume, low envelope and global attenuation with zero clamping. Format the result for pulse/noise, triangle threshold or FDS volume according to the hardware channel offset.

units.name: DecodeSignedAudioNibble
units.summary: Sign-extend the low nibble of the current envelope command; Y becomes the sign byte for the 16-bit pitch adjustment.

units.name: AddAudioPitchDelta
units.summary: Add the signed low/high delta to the channel register shadow pitch word, propagating carry.

units.name: CycleOpeningStory
units.summary: Repeat title transition, story and opening scenes. The story route returns here; this loop is separate from Start selecting gameplay.

units.name: RevealTitleAcrossScroll
units.summary: Hide background while preparing the title descriptor, then enable it and move the scroll by eight pixels per paced cursor frame. Carry advances the page byte.

units.name: StartStoryOrCredits
units.summary: Choose story source $88AE or credits source $8CC7, clear both nametables, install attribute rows and reset streaming counters. The two entries share the same row consumer.

units.name: FinishCongratulationsAndShowCredits
units.summary: After the preceding 22 by 60 frame hold, scroll 214 pixels at four-frame intervals. Fade out, stream STAFF credits, wait 90 callbacks, and prepare the final stable screen. Credits were observed on this artificial ending route; congratulations is not terminal.

units.name: GameOverAndPasswordDisplay
units.summary: Display game over and, except for first stage of first quest, copy the preceding stage/quest password into the transfer payload. Wait for a Start edge, reset the stack and reenter title initialization.

units.name: PreparePasswordEntry
units.summary: Hide the title sprite range, initialize four digit tiles, draw the password field and restore background visibility before editing.

units.name: WrapPasswordAlphabet
units.summary: Wrap between digit and uppercase-letter tile domains: decrement before 0 becomes Z, decrement before A becomes 9, increment after 9 becomes A, and after Z becomes 0. Redraw the four-byte payload.

units.name: DrawPasswordField
units.summary: Install the fixed nametable destination and four-by-one dimensions for the password payload; the inline pointer wrapper consumes its following word.

units.name: InitializeShooterScene
units.summary: Load selected shooter room data, select graphics and parallel sprite/metatile tables, initialize stage-dependent resource limits and player coordinates, clear object pools and fade into the approach. Mapper loader restores presentation banks before returning.

units.name: FinishShooterSpawnRecord
units.summary: Complete a four-byte spawn record: set object Y, activity and initial counters, initialize health from type table, then advance stream by four bytes.

units.name: FindAndInitializeShooterSlot
units.summary: Search twelve slots from high to low, accepting inactive or negative activity. The initialization entries clear fractions/state fields, install coordinates and load type health. Y is the selected destination slot.

units.name: TailInlineShooterGenerator
units.summary: Consumes this JSR return and reads three following bytes: delay reload, generation count and spawned type. Timer gates allocation; count expiry retires the generator. A supplies Y or $FF requests mixed player/frame placement. Every RTS returns to the outer caller, never after these three bytes.

units.name: AdvanceShooterDeathSequence
units.summary: Advance timed death animation, add its per-type drop weight to the accumulator, and either deactivate or turn the slot into a pickup. Remaining frames use the death animation base and common object renderer.

units.name: MoveShooterSignedAxis
units.summary: Interpret A as signed displacement: zero returns, positive/negative amounts tail-call the corresponding fixed horizontal or vertical movement helper. Fractions are accumulated by callers.

units.name: DispatchShooterObject
units.summary: Prepare sprite attributes and index the 31-word handler table by type. Activity two uses the death sequence; normal handlers run with the object index saved on the CPU stack.

units.name: ShooterBurstAndDive
units.summary: One entry generates up to five type-$0C objects at 24-frame intervals; another animates, initially descends, then switches to fractional leftward motion after crossing player Y. Slot fields have handler-specific meanings.

units.name: ShooterAnimatedGenerator
units.summary: Cycle six frames with a four-tick delay. Neighboring entries invoke the nonlocal inline generator; their three-byte parameter records are data and have no local continuation.

units.name: ShooterAimedDrifter
units.summary: Animate four frames, periodically emit a visible aimed secondary for the selected type, and steer using player-relative direction while inside screen bounds. Generator variants preserve the same nonlocal return contract.

units.name: ShooterOscillatingFlight
units.summary: Choose one of two vertical acceleration/limit pairs, cycle five sprite frames and reverse acceleration when signed velocity crosses its limit. Integrate vertical velocity and move left at one pixel per frame.

units.name: ShooterTriggeredVerticalTurn
units.summary: Initialize velocity from direction-indexed tables. Enter the turning state near player Y, accelerate vertically, optionally fire on a 60-frame cadence, then integrate both axes and select the four-frame moving animation.

units.name: ShooterAcceleratingAttack
units.summary: Related entries wait near player Y before accelerating on both axes, optionally fire rapid aimed shots, or execute a staged acceleration/pause pattern with two secondary launches. Animation and state fields are local to each type.

units.name: ShooterCurvingFlight
units.summary: Wait until visible and on the selected side of player Y, then accumulate signed vertical acceleration while moving left by fractional one-and-a-half pixels. Draw the fixed frame.

units.name: ShooterDeceleratingTurn
units.summary: Choose initial vertical direction from the direction field; start acceleration when within 48 pixels of player Y. Bring vertical velocity to zero without crossing its sign, accelerate horizontal motion and select a frame by vertical velocity sign.

units.name: ShooterSimpleFrames
units.summary: Generator entry uses the outer-return helper. The remaining handlers select a frame from frame-counter bits or fixed type-specific frames; one also moves by a direction vector.

units.name: SpawnSecondaryTypeFive
units.summary: Save A as the secondary parameter, find a free secondary slot and install type five before common coordinate initialization. Pool exhaustion aborts this caller through the allocator stack contract.

units.name: ShooterPlayerScript
units.summary: Dispatch player damage/recovery and approach-end sequences. The route-end script centers player on the destination, animates the craft, writes timed tile patterns and advances progression before entering the interior. Damage and recovery use independent timers; no natural stage-clear claim follows.

units.name: DrawShooterArrivalCraft
units.summary: Choose craft attribute/frame from progression and animation state, draw it at saved object-zero coordinates, then draw the player overlay. This is scripted presentation, not a live enemy slot update.

units.name: DamageShooterObject
units.summary: Complete shot bounds tests, consume the shot and subtract shot power from health. Health reaching or passing zero transforms the slot to death activity with type-specific offsets and animation/drop parameters; surviving hits flash and play a different sound.

units.name: ShooterPlayerContactResponse
units.summary: Finish rectangle overlap tests. Pickup types refill current/maximum resource, add five decimal ammunition units, grant recovery, or transform ordinary objects. Other contacts trigger damage unless protected by the recovery interval.

units.name: ShooterSecondaryContactResponse
units.summary: On overlap clear the secondary slot and enter player damage unless the recovery seconds counter protects the player.

units.name: InitializeInteriorRuntime
units.summary: Install interior sprite/metatile tables and stage CHR selections, reset motion, collision, sequence and persistence state, copy current resources to the limit pair, and place player from stage metadata. Clear object/secondary/shot activity before drawing the viewport.

units.name: TransferThroughInteriorExit
units.summary: Lift player 24 pixels, wait, fade and clear objects. Search 11-byte transition records by aligned four-byte world coordinate; load destination four-byte position, two CHR selections and orientation, then rebuild margins/spawns and return to the interior loop. Search relies on valid stage records; no general bounds guarantee is added.

units.name: InteriorEndAndDeathPresentation
units.summary: Display and pace the loss/transition HUD, hide unused sprites, then return to presentation with progression two. The shared wait helper consumes A frames while maintaining frame synchronization.

units.name: InteriorCompletionPaletteSweep
units.summary: Stop effects, start music five and run eight timed palette-brightness steps while ordinary interior callbacks continue. The main sequence subsequently waits and returns to fixed presentation dispatch.

units.name: ObjectScreenToWorld
units.summary: Add scroll to an object coordinate into the metatile-write scratch pair. Vertical pages wrap at 240 pixels, so crossing the page adjusts by sixteen rather than treating Y as a linear 256-pixel page.

units.name: SampleObjectCollisionProbes
units.summary: Choose one of 25 count-prefixed probe records. Add signed byte XY offsets to the object world position with 240-line vertical wrapping, fetch each metatile and store results in the probe array. X is preserved around the scan.

units.name: InteriorDeathAnimationAndDrop
units.summary: Advance per-type death frames. On completion add the drop weight, choose a pickup from resource/ammunition state when the accumulator carries and direction is usable, or deactivate the slot. Some death frames also animate palette brightness.

units.name: ClearObjectPersistenceBit
units.summary: Split spawn identifier into byte index and bit index, clear its mask in the persistence bitmap and preserve X. This prevents respawn according to the caller policy.

units.name: InteriorWalkingShooter
units.summary: Animate the first paired types, periodically aim/fire from inline coordinate probes, and move horizontally. At aligned world X sample terrain; a blocked leading probe reverses direction and reloads the pause timer.

units.name: InteriorProximityShooter
units.summary: Select mirrored sprite attributes by type, fire when horizontally near the player using a four-phase reload schedule and inline launch offsets, then share walking/terrain logic.

units.name: InteriorFourPhaseEmitter
units.summary: Cycle four frame/delay pairs; the beginning of phase two launches a secondary at the inline coordinate offset if visible.

units.name: InteriorStationaryAimedEmitter
units.summary: Cycle four animation frames and every 32 frames launch an aimed secondary when the inline point is visible and direction can be computed.

units.name: InteriorMovingPlatform
units.summary: Move vertically with a signed fractional velocity and collision probes. Contact can carry player motion; active contact drains resources and counts down travel. Terrain contact stops velocity and introduces a wait before reversing; separate reset clears contact and sound state.

units.name: InteriorEdgeGenerator
units.summary: Position a generator on the current viewport edge according to orientation. On its cadence require a passable tile and player-relative direction, search an object slot, copy coordinates and initialize the selected type. Exhaustion leaves the generator intact; completion clears its persistence bit.

units.name: InteriorTerrainReflector
units.summary: One type moves on its direction vector and dies on a solid probe; a related type samples three probes, indexes a reflection mask and reflects horizontal/vertical direction bits. Animation phases run in opposite orders.

units.name: InteriorAcceleratingPursuer
units.summary: Recompute player-relative directions on a type-dependent timer, accelerate signed XY velocity toward the player and launch a secondary when vertically close. Terrain probes stop each velocity axis separately; fractional integrators and sign-aware movement apply the result. Frame choice follows direction and velocity.

units.name: ClampObjectAcceleration
units.summary: Add a signed acceleration to one velocity pair and clamp its magnitude to the larger of previous speed and requested limit. Horizontal and vertical entries share the magnitude comparison helper; scratch arguments are caller-specific.

units.name: InteriorHorizontalCharger
units.summary: Record a world-space target near the viewport center, approach it at four pixels per frame, wait or react to the screen edge, then reverse and charge at eight pixels per frame. Leaving the screen resets the type and restores its saved Y.

units.name: InteriorShotReactiveMover
units.summary: Watch player shots crossing its Y band and direction, briefly move vertically away from a shot, reverse at terrain, and restore the horizontal direction bits after four ticks. Three-frame animation runs on an independent timer.

units.name: InteriorPeriodicDirectionMover
units.summary: Animate four frames and periodically recompute player-relative direction while visible. A phase counter alternates stationary and direction-vector movement using a type-dependent speed.

units.name: InteriorJumpingShooter
units.summary: Sequence takeoff, airborne and landing frames with signed vertical acceleration. Terrain aligns the landing coordinate and reverses horizontal direction at walls. During its airborne attack phase fire aimed secondaries every eight frames when visible.

units.name: InteriorTrackingBurstShooter
units.summary: Track player horizontal side and vertical displacement, use three terrain probes to reflect blocked axes, and move on horizontal plus half-speed vertical steps. A proximity and facing gate starts a timed burst; four animation phases determine the launch offset and secondary type.

units.name: InteriorGridWalker
units.summary: Choose among four finite directions at grid alignment, reject blocked probes with a bounded retry budget, and use a four-entry indirect movement table. Quest-dependent speed/timers change tiles during a timed state; no unrestricted indirect target claim follows.

units.name: ReactorCoreActor
units.summary: Draw core plus its four-frame overlay. Compare health against initial twenty and accumulate the stage regeneration rate to restore health on carry. Death is handled by common damage logic, which raises progression and starts the escape sequence.

units.name: EscapeCraftActor
units.summary: Draw the escape craft and, after core progression, update its underlying tile marker. When player is within the small XY window and no escape is active, set EscapeSequence to one. The helper adds direction-indexed tile offsets before writing the marker.

units.name: InteriorSimpleAndVerticalEmitters
units.summary: Select short type-specific animation cycles or fixed frames with vector motion. Two stationary variants launch a secondary from an inline point every 64 frames; launch failure leaves their normal drawing path intact.

units.name: InteriorNearbyFieldAndEmitter
units.summary: A proximity-gated type changes the vertical motion parameter and cycles attribute bits. Paired emitters animate two frames and launch aimed secondaries on a 200-tick cadence with per-type inline offsets.

units.name: InteriorSpawnerWalker
units.summary: At world alignment face player and test floor/clearance probes before walking. Alternate a visible attachment with a timed spawn phase; spawn type $22 into a free object slot with inherited direction and offset position.

units.name: InteriorSpawnedRunner
units.summary: Move two pixels horizontally according to direction, die on solid terrain, and draw a frame-counter-selected animation shared with the spawning attachment.

units.name: InteriorShotCollisionResponse
units.summary: Check twelve active objects against per-type rectangle bounds. Some types change direction/attack state on hit; one emits a secondary. Apply shot power, consume the shot and start the explosive effect for a powered shot.

units.name: DamageInteriorObject
units.summary: Subtract damage with zero/borrow death detection and a 15-frame flash. Reactor type $17 death reduces fade target, raises progression and starts music four. Transform dead objects using signed per-type offsets and death animation/drop parameters; selected deaths update persistence.

units.name: InteriorSecondaryPlayerCollision
units.summary: Test active secondary coordinates against the player rectangle, clear a colliding secondary and apply its type damage to current and limit resources. Compute contact direction for knockback.

units.name: FireInteriorPlayerShot
units.summary: A edge selects ordinary fire; B requires decimal ammunition, an inactive explosive effect and no powered shot already present. Allocate one of two shots, place it at the player facing offset, subtract ammunition when needed and install the firing recoil state.

units.name: InteriorProjectileTerrainResponse
units.summary: Test player shots and staggered secondary slots against metatiles. Powered shots can change destructible tiles and create an object death effect at aligned world coordinates; ordinary solid collisions clear the projectile. Spawn exhaustion safely skips the extra visual effect.

units.name: ProjectileScreenToWorldTile
units.summary: Add scroll to projectile test coordinates using 240-line vertical page wrapping, then tail-call the world metatile reader.

units.name: PoweredShotAreaEffect
units.summary: Install an effect centered twelve pixels above/left of the powered shot and play its sound. Later callbacks advance its frame and, every fourth tick, damage objects inside expanded type rectangles. A type-four target only accepts damage in its active phase.

units.name: ActivateInteriorRoomEvent
units.summary: Handle matching event state, choose sound/orientation and enter player room state one. Copy direction/position fields, clear velocity, save world coordinates and derive tile coordinates for the transition animation. State six bypasses the new transition.

units.name: InteriorRoomStateHandlers
units.summary: States one through five share three handlers: respond to up/down or leave on horizontal input, move toward the event endpoint, and draw a timed metatile sequence. The pointer origin is prebiased at $A387; actual words begin $A389 for state one. State zero/six bypass dispatch.

units.name: UpdateInteriorPlayerVelocity
units.summary: Apply horizontal drag toward zero and signed vertical acceleration toward its limit. Direction-input flags then accelerate/clamp each axis to the configured positive or negative speed. All velocities are paired fixed-point bytes; limits and acceleration are changed by recoil, contact and terrain states.

units.name: IntegrateInteriorPlayerMotion
units.summary: Resolve solid object contacts, add fractional velocities and derive signed pixel counts. Sample terrain, then consume displacement one pixel at a time with collision/event checks between steps. Each axis either moves screen position or scrolls according to orientation and room gating; vertical world pages are 240 pixels.

units.name: ApplyInteriorDirectionalInput
units.summary: Turn left/right from held input and install horizontal/upward thrust flags. Choose grounded/airborne horizontal acceleration and drag, restore vertical motion parameters, then share the velocity clamp routine.

units.name: SamplePlayerTerrain
units.summary: Probe ten signed offsets around world player coordinates, record metatiles and four directional blockage flags. A blocked direction zeroes its velocity and pending pixel count only when moving toward that surface.

units.name: ResolvePlayerObjectContact
units.summary: Scan active nonplatform objects against type rectangles. Pickup types refill resources or add ammunition; other types compute contact direction and apply resource damage with invulnerability gating. Knockback installs signed acceleration flags and resets both velocity axes.

units.name: ClassifyPlayerObjectContactSide
units.summary: Try eight player perimeter probes against the object rectangle and store the matched contact side. No match sets a negative marker and may reset an active platform/contact phase.

units.name: ResolveSolidObjectAndGroundedState
units.summary: Cancel horizontal penetration or match player vertical motion to a moving platform, using contact side and velocity difference. Ground contact selects the grounded movement mode and initializes landing animation only on transition.

units.name: ApplyHazardDamage
units.summary: Complete terrain-specific current/limit resource subtraction and pass the table-derived contact direction to knockback. Resource units are mechanical counters; no physical unit interpretation is assumed.

units.name: InteriorResourceAndAmmunitionAdjustments
units.summary: Clamp a low current resource on the special recovery path. The next continuation adds a timed resource increment and conditionally awards more; decimal ammunition remains a separate two-digit counter.

units.name: LaunchEscapeAndAdvanceStage
units.summary: Keep only the escape craft, gate simulation, sweep palettes and replace the display/graphics for the launch. Run the craft callback for eleven 60-frame intervals, fade, increment stage and choose next approach or ending. Core/escape visits used artificial entry support, not a natural clear.

units.name: DecodeStageColumnStream
units.summary: Select dynamic source mapper value from StageDataBankValue, read split stream pointers and expand fifteen 16-byte rows. $F0..$FE encode repeated $FF; $FF reads an explicit repetition count/value. Reuse previous values for $FF cells and write through the chosen map-buffer pointer, then restore ScenePrgBankValue. After mapper selection effective lower banks are unknown; fixed execution remains in banks14/15.

units.name: ScrollViewportLeft
units.summary: Subtract one horizontal pixel, update page on borrow and trigger margin refresh at the tile boundary. The fixed scroll continuation shares map-stream decoding.

units.name: ScrollViewportUp
units.summary: Subtract one vertical pixel; borrow changes low byte to $EF and decrements page. Tile-boundary refresh uses the same fixed margin pipeline.

units.name: DrawViewportWithMargins
units.summary: Align scroll to player world pages, draw the viewport metatiles and iterate both side margins in four-tile steps. Coordinates wrap within the metatile buffer domain.

units.name: SelectOrientationAndLoadMapPages
units.summary: Install horizontal/vertical MMC1 orientation, derive stage page index from world X/Y and stage width, and load neighboring pages into four rotating RAM buffers. Every packed-column load saves/restores the scene mapper; source mapper selection is data access, not new lower-slot code context.

units.name: FetchNeighboringMapPage
units.summary: Compute wrapped map-buffer selector and stage-page index from world position, then dispatch packed-column decoding through the dynamic source mapper.

units.name: WorldPositionToTileCoordinates
units.summary: Shift paired world coordinates right three places and mask to even tile coordinates for two-by-two metatile drawing. Scratch inputs are the saved position pair, outputs TileDrawX/TileDrawY.

units.name: InlineObjectLaunchPoint
units.summary: A selects four coordinate bytes inside an inline descriptor. Pop the caller return, add signed XY offsets to the object position and return carry set for an offscreen point. The count byte advances the saved return past the full descriptor; status is preserved while rebuilding the stack.

units.name: DirectionFromPointToPlayer
units.summary: Copy object coordinates or use the inline launch point, subtract from player center, normalize large magnitudes and choose a 32-direction index using octant thresholds. Carry set signals coincident/unusable direction; successful result clears carry. Temporary status bytes encode signs and are consumed separately from JSR returns.

units.name: FindSecondarySlotOrAbortCaller
units.summary: Search eight secondary slots descending. Success returns normally with Y identifying the free slot. On exhaustion pop the allocator caller return before RTS, aborting that allocation routine; callers must not assume the success continuation always executes.

units.name: InitializeSecondaryVariants
units.summary: Variant entries select type, direction/velocity fields and lifespan; common initialization clears fractions, marks active and copies launch-point low coordinates. All use the allocator whose exhaustion return bypasses the local caller.

units.name: MoveDirectionSecondary
units.summary: Integrate the 32-direction table on fractional X/Y, folding the vertical angle by 24. Clear activity when the signed motion crosses a screen boundary, then resume the dispatcher slot loop.

units.name: MoveStraightOrHomingSecondary
units.summary: One handler moves six pixels vertically. Another accelerates signed XY velocity toward player center, integrates fractions and detects boundary/sign crossing before clearing activity. Type fields are separate eight-slot parallel arrays.

units.name: MoveHorizontalAndSteppedSecondary
units.summary: Handle six-pixel horizontal shots, a timed stepped diagonal pattern with decreasing lifetime, and a left-moving variant. Boundary crossing or exhausted lifetime clears activity and rejoins the common slot loop.

units.name: DrawSecondaryVariants
units.summary: Six finite render handlers choose fixed or frame-counter animation, mirror attributes from direction, and use per-slot phase for rotating effects. All tail-call the common metasprite path without changing the update-handler domain.

units.name: AddOrSubtractCurrentResource
units.summary: Add A to the current 16-bit resource and clamp to the stored limit. Subtraction saturates at zero; input carry requests invulnerability gating through PlayerInvulnerabilityTicks. Arithmetic does not establish a physical unit name.

units.name: AdjustResourceLimit
units.summary: Add A to the 16-bit limit, or subtract A with optional invulnerability gating. The subtraction wraps by ordinary 16-bit arithmetic; it does not inherit current-resource saturation.

units.name: LoadShooterStageData
units.summary: Select mapper value three, establishing effective banks[6,7,14,15] at $CE8D. Read eight-entry split source pointers, copy 25 pages to RAM $6690 and swap selected palette groups in second quest. Restore mapper zero before returning. Copy windows may include fixed-code overcopy and do not prove a source-table extent.

units.name: LoadSecondQuestStageOrigin
units.summary: Select mapper value one before $CF05, establishing effective banks[2,3,14,15]. Use stage-indexed split origin pointers for second-quest interior data; this lower-slot table view differs from the prior source mapper.

units.name: ShiftObjectsRightOrDown
units.summary: Move shots, secondaries and active object screen coordinates one pixel to compensate viewport motion. Clear projectiles crossing their boundary and move the powered-effect coordinate with carry.

units.name: MoveObjectAndUpdateVisibility
units.summary: Four entries add/subtract horizontal/vertical amounts to paired coordinates. Shared tails set/clear the offscreen bit or deactivate at outer margins. X remains the object slot; A may be one or a caller-supplied pixel amount.

units.name: MoveObjectAlongDirection
units.summary: Resolve a 32-direction vector from ObjectRelativeDirection and speed selector, integrate its fractional components and apply signed integer displacement through visibility-aware axis helpers. Speed selector chooses quarter, normal or doubled table magnitude.

units.name: DrawRepeatedTilePattern
units.summary: Use saved tile coordinates as PPU destination, repeat the selected four-tile row into a four-by-four payload and submit through the inline pointer transfer. Its following two-byte pointer remains data.

units.name: TickReactorAndEscapeEffects
units.summary: Unless progression is complete, advance staged effect timers and install displacement amplitude/period. Escape and active fades gate palette cycling; a six-frame phase selects brightness. These NMI mechanics implement the core aftermath without proving a natural trigger route.

units.name: TransferVerticalPayload
units.summary: Write a transfer column directly with PPU increment32 when rendering allows, or enqueue the same byte count/value sequence. Repeat mode holds the source; other modes advance by stride and restore saved registers/pointers before returning.

units.name: AudioExtendedRegisterCommands
units.summary: Complete commands selecting pitch table, DPCM sample address/length, channel register fields, signed pitch delta and a global audio flag. Continue the note interpreter after consuming each command payload; hardware writes do not imply extra expansion compatibility.

units.name: AudioWaveAndEnvelopeRegisterCommands
units.summary: Finish the 64-entry FDS wave upload and release wave-write mode. Another envelope command writes the channel register selected by its hardware offset, then resumes envelope interpretation. This describes encoded behavior only.

units.name: StoredResetPrefixBank01
units.summary: Stored bootstrap template in bank1, prewrite mode2 view [0,1,0,1]. Reset vector $FFF5 anchors SEI; INC reads $F5 at $FFFC. Its first bit7 write resets MMC1 control, retaining the PRG register: lower pair [0,1], upper [14,15]. The next $FFF9 fetch is bank15 byte $FF, so it does not execute this bank's stored JMP. No working reset path is established.

units.name: StoredResetJumpBank01
units.summary: Stored JMP $C000 overlaps the NMI vector operand and names the independently known reset entry. This is a structural prewrite alias, not fallthrough after INC: mapper reset changes the actual next fetch.

units.name: StoredResetIrqVectorsBank01
units.summary: Hardware vector words: reset=$FFF5, IRQ=$FFFF. Together with the overlapping NMI=$C000 operand these bound the repeated bootstrap template. IRQ executable use and natural template use remain unresolved.

units.name: DiscardPendingPpuQueue
units.summary: Discard the published PPU queue by setting its producer cursor to its consumer cursor. The drain sees equality as empty. PpuQueueBuild is unchanged; an interrupt between the load and store can change the consumer, so this alone does not guarantee an atomic discard.

units.name: DecodeSignedAudioFiveBits
units.summary: Read the low five bits of the byte at AudioStreamLo/Hi. Bit4 is the sign: return the sign-extended value as A low/Y high, matching the following pitch-add helper and signed-nibble sibling. Natural use remains unresolved.
